one_line: Open with a one-line text premise and let a locked-off phone catch the real reaction.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 static medium shot: a toddler about 2 to 3 sits cross-legged on a beige sofa, laughing and clapping. Text, upper middle: "רמת התרגשות:" / "קיבלתי הודעה "המשלוח יגיע היום"". Sound: a long shout, no words (transcript).
q1_hook.why: A child's real laughter is a high-arousal feeling in frame one (K1, K8), and the text sets a relatable premise, a delivery notice, in the first second (T3, H1). Shout and text work with sound on or off (H6). But no product shows until 0:04 and none is named (H2).

beats.what: Toddler laughs and claps; "רמת התרגשות: קיבלתי הודעה "המשלוח יגיע היום""
beats.why: A relatable premise and a real laugh

beats.what: "לפתוח?", "אתם מוכנים?", "בואו לפתוח איתי את המתנות שלי"; she claps, kicks, reaches for a bag
She unwraps a swirl squishy ("סקוויצי חמאה מנומסת"), then a giant cupcake squishy
beats.why: First toys, each named by a text label

beats.what: Giant cupcake hugged; a banana squishy held up; a bag of small ones opened; "יותר גדול מהראש שלי"
beats.why: A new toy and line every 3 to 10 s

beats.what: Small squishies named by colour, then a chocolate-bar squishy; "משחק ברמה גבוהה"
beats.why: A list of similar items, the slowest stretch

beats.what: "תפתח לי את זה"; a hand passes a purple bucket; her mouth opens wide; "איזה כיף"
beats.why: The biggest reaction, near the end

beats.what: "איזה סקוויצי הכי אהבתם?", then "אני אוהבת את החמאה המנומסת"; she waves
beats.why: A question to answer, then a goodbye

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: On screen at 1:28: "איזה סקוויצי הכי אהבתם?"; the caption repeats the question. It can be answered from the toys on screen. No tag or send ask.
q2_flow.why: The toddler's delight is the high-arousal positive feeling (K1), and a new toy every 5 to 15 s keeps the middle moving (R3). The 13 s build-up and colour-by-colour labels slow it (R1, R2). The biggest reaction comes at 1:25, near the end (R4).

q3_cta.what: On screen 1:28-1:30: "איזה סקוויצי הכי אהבתם?"; then the child's text "אני אוהבת את החמאה המנומסת". Caption: "איזה סקוושי הכי אהבתם? 😍🤯". No link, code or product tag.
q3_cta.why: One open, specific question that can be answered from the toys on screen, asked at the end and repeated as the caption's first line (C5, C1). It sits inside the safe zone, after the value, but is text only, not said (C6).

q4_shown.what: A bag beside the child 0:04; a swirl squishy in her hands 0:21; a giant cupcake squishy 0:27-0:42; a banana squishy 0:45; small squishies 0:54-1:09; a chocolate-bar squishy 1:10-1:17; a purple slime bucket 1:21. No brand, price or close-up.
q4_shown.why: The child's face and reactions are the content (K8). But the first toy is in her hand only at 0:21 (S1), the toys are small in a wide frame (F4), and with no brand or price it is entertainment, not a pitch (S3).

q5_edit.what: One continuous 98 s locked-off shot, no cuts detected; pacing comes from text changes every 1.5 to 4 s. A hand passes the bucket in from the right at 1:21. Hidden jump cuts are possible. Ends on a wave and an emoji.
q5_edit.why: A single shot feels authentic but has long stretches where nothing new happens, such as 0:04-0:17 (E2, R1). Short text lines carry the child's words (E4). It ends within 3 s of the last line (E8).

q6_topic.what: A toddler's excited reaction to a haul of squishy toys, her lines as text. It sells nothing and serves entertainment and toy ideas for parents of toddlers.
q6_topic.why: Her exaggerated excitement is everyday child-behaviour humour parents have lived (K3, K1). A child's joy is something a parent sends on (R5). No parenting concern or occasion is named.

q7_filmed.what: The child fills the middle; the toys pile up at 65 to 75% of the frame height.
q7_filmed.why: Steady, sharp and full-frame (F1, F7), and a real home looks native (H8). The toys sit in the bottom 35% of the frame (F2) and are small (F4), while the text sits safely in the upper middle.

q8_text.on_screen: White bold text with a thin dark edge and emoji, centred about 23% down, one short line at a time for 1.5 to 4 s, written in the child's voice: "רמת התרגשות: קיבלתי הודעה "המשלוח יגיע היום"" (0:00), "בואו לפתוח איתי את המתנות שלי" (0:09), "מה זה? יותר גדול מהראש שלי" (0:36), "סקוויצי ורוד" (0:55), "איזה סקוויצי הכי אהבתם?" (1:28). English "And all done" at 1:06.
q8_text.caption: "איזה סקוושי הכי אהבתם? 😍🤯". One line, then 5 hashtags (#ילדים #capcut #סקוושי #טרנד and one that looks like the account name). A question, no CTA, no brand, no disclosure.
q8_text.why: A premise headline in the first second (T3), short lines timed to the action carry the child's words muted (T1), inside the safe zone (T4). English lines and emoji-first lines break the Hebrew-first rule (T6). The caption's first line is a question, but the keyword is spelled two ways, "סקוושי" and "סקוויצי" (T7).

weak_points: 98 s in one shot with long flat stretches; 13 s of build-up before any toy; products and brand never named; English auto-style captions mixed in; the child's face with an account tag that looks like her name.
lumebook_takeaway: Prop the phone and film hands opening the book parcel, with a one-line text premise at 0:00 and one question on the last frame.
not_verified: The toys' brand and whether they were gifted. Who films, and whether the child's text lines were said or added. Hidden jump cuts: the toys and her position change between samples. The transcript is poor and music is not evident. Correction to src/coded: face_on_camera "no face (hands only)" is wrong, the child's face is on screen throughout.
